results.name: real lobby → game with three guests (1, 3, 4) on seed 22; contact comes from exploration as host time advances; guests run no engine and have a DİPLOMASİ tab
A. human ↔ human trade on two phones: A composes with presets and the keyboard, previews the host quote, sends; B sees the badge, accepts with two-step confirm; exact resources move once
B. counter-offer: B answers 60 instead of 100 alloy from the inbox; A sees round 2 and accepts; the old round is closed; only the new terms move
C. reject moves nothing; a tap on the backdrop over the KABUL button only closes the sheet; withdraw by the sender
D. AI ↔ human: guest → AI runs aiRespond (accept moves resources, one-sided demand is refused); natural AI → guest offers wait in the human inbox, AI never decides for the human
E. privacy (3 players): C never receives the A–B offers, ids, amounts or counter rounds over the network; probing a real id looks the same as a missing one

F. security and atomicity over the network: forged empire, bad items, duplicate cid, stale seq, accept+reject race, stock change, low Etki, injected engine failure, expiry, paused host — no partial change
peace between humans via the UI: BARIŞ ÖNER previews the host cost; war continues while pending; acceptance runs makePeace through executeDeal; the crossing offer becomes invalid
host MP diplomacy panel: humans only, same rules through host.local(); host ↔ C trade both ways with two-step confirm; host cannot act on other parties' offers; host notices go to the host log only

G. phone layouts 360×800, 390×844, 412×915, 844×390, 915×412: contacts, draft (keyboard), inbox, sent, history and the confirm sheet — no overflow, ≥44 px, ≥11 px text; the amount field stays visible with a keyboard-sized viewport
disconnect / reconnect: offline guest cannot act; reload restores the inbox from the host; host offline disables actions until it returns
H. performance with 4 humans (host + 3 guests): offer/accept round trip, inbox size in snapshot and delta, host publish cost, render cost, memory
